Jill —

Appreciate the quick reply and the questionnaire. We've filled out the sections we can and attached a short answers PDF with references to our SOC 2 scope. Highlights:

- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report (FY25) covering our hosted control plane and core inference runtime. For private/VPC deployments, our control environment depends on the chosen model: hosted control plane + customer-managed compute (VPC) is covered under our SOC 2 when the control plane components are in-scope; for fully air-gapped on-prem installs, customers retain control of hardware and some controls fall to the customer. We'll include a clear boundary diagram in the answers.
- GDPR/HIPAA: We support DPAs and BAAs respectively; we have standard templates and can start a DPA/BAA conversation.
- Key management: KMS/HSM integrations supported (BYOK).
- Air-gapped: we offer an on-prem package; Redwood provides the installer and documentation, but the customer manages the physical network and hardware. We can run an enterprise services engagement for fully-managed setups.

Attachments: redwood-sq-initial-answers.pdf (application/pdf), redwood-private-deployment-diagram.png (image/png)

Next steps from our side:
1) I'll upload the SOC 2 summary and link to the secure report portal to HubSpot and share the secure link (we don't email full reports).
2) Rishi will follow up on procurement/T&Cs and provide a rough timeline for Dedicated/Private onboarding.
3) Marissa will offer a 30-minute tech Q&A slot next week to walk your security team through the diagram and answers.

If anything in the questionnaire needs a deeper technical appendix, flag it and we'll pull in engineering.

Thanks,
Marcus
